description: Candidate port of nera-data-layer lazy_adapter_ownership at 2b1504adc4291daaf080b2e932962b134da1a69a.

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent","edge_parent","kind","line","text","ordinal","parent_start","parent_end","parent_kind","ancestor_start","ancestor_end","ancestor_kind","name_id","name_source","value_id","value_kind","type_id","type_start","type_end","type_kind","function_id","function_start","function_end","function_kind","object_id","object_start","object_end","object_kind","object_source","attribute_id","attribute_source","body_id","body_start","body_end","body_kind","parameters_id","parameters_start","parameters_end","parameters_kind","name" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition')

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source","body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind","name" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition')

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind","attr","object",NULL AS "object_text" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_id AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute')

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "callee_id","callee_kind",NULL AS "full_callee","callee","receiver" FROM (SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_id LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call')

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "id","kind",NULL AS "text","name","annotation",NULL AS "position" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_id AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.id=CASE WHEN p.kind='identifier' THEN p.id ELSE (SELECT child.id FROM nodes child WHERE child.__path=p.__path AND child.parent=p.id AND child.ordinal=0 AND child.kind='identifier' LIMIT 1) END
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter'))

stages.name: declaration_parents
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","parent","region_start" FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN p.kind='decorated_definition' THEN p.parent ELSE n.parent END parent,CASE WHEN p.kind='decorated_definition' THEN p.__start ELSE n.__start END region_start FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition'))

stages.name: owned_functions
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent","edge_parent","kind","line","text","ordinal","parent_start","parent_end","parent_kind","ancestor_start","ancestor_end","ancestor_kind","name_id","name_source","value_id","value_kind","type_id","type_start","type_end","type_kind","function_id","function_start","function_end","function_kind","object_id","object_start","object_end","object_kind","object_source","attribute_id","attribute_source","body_id","body_start","body_end","body_kind","parameters_id","parameters_start","parameters_end","parameters_kind","name","class_name","region_start" FROM (SELECT f.*,c.name class_name,d.region_start FROM functions f JOIN declaration_parents d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.id=f.id
        JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=d.__path AND parent.id=d.parent LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.__path=parent.__path AND c.body_id=parent.id LEFT JOIN declaration_parents cd ON cd.__path=c.__path AND cd.id=c.id LEFT JOIN nodes cp ON cp.__path=cd.__path AND cp.id=cd.parent
        WHERE parent.kind='module' OR c.id IS NOT NULL AND cp.kind='module')

stages.name: decorators
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","decorator","__start","name" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,d.id decorator,d.__start,coalesce(c.callee,a.attr,x.text) name FROM owned_functions f JOIN nodes wrapper ON wrapper.__path=f.__path AND wrapper.id=f.parent AND wrapper.kind='decorated_definition'
        JOIN nodes d ON d.__path=wrapper.__path AND d.parent=wrapper.id AND d.kind='decorator' JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=d.__path AND x.parent=d.id LEFT JOIN calls c ON c.__path=x.__path AND c.id=x.id LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=x.__path AND a.id=x.id)

stages.name: legacy_decorators
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","decorator","__start","name",NULL AS "chosen" FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT d.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,fn ORDER BY __start) chosen FROM decorators d WHERE name IN ('legacy_async','legacy_module_async','legacy_module_sync','legacy_sync')) WHERE chosen=1)

stages.name: function_contracts
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent","edge_parent","kind","line","text","ordinal","parent_start","parent_end","parent_kind","ancestor_start","ancestor_end","ancestor_kind","name_id","name_source","value_id","value_kind","type_id","type_start","type_end","type_kind","function_id","function_start","function_end","function_kind","object_id","object_start","object_end","object_kind","object_source","attribute_id","attribute_source","body_id","body_start","body_end","body_kind","parameters_id","parameters_start","parameters_end","parameters_kind","name","class_name","region_start","legacy_decorator","decorator","default_target","external","pure" FROM (SELECT f.*,d.name legacy_decorator,d.decorator,
        CASE WHEN d.name IN ('legacy_async','legacy_sync') THEN CASE WHEN f.name GLOB '*_async' THEN substr(f.name,1,length(f.name)-6) WHEN f.name GLOB '*_sync' THEN substr(f.name,1,length(f.name)-5) ELSE f.name END
        WHEN d.name='legacy_module_async' AND f.name GLOB '*_async' THEN substr(f.name,1,length(f.name)-6) ELSE f.name END||'_lazy' default_target,
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE x.__path=f.__path AND x.fn=f.id AND x.name IN ('direct_legacy_module_async','direct_legacy_module_sync','external_io_boundary','external_io_boundary_async','external_io_boundary_sync')) external,
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators x WHERE x.__path=f.__path AND x.fn=f.id AND x.name IN ('pure_lazy','lazy')) pure FROM owned_functions f LEFT JOIN legacy_decorators d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id)

stages.name: function_targets
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent","edge_parent","kind","line","text","ordinal","parent_start","parent_end","parent_kind","ancestor_start","ancestor_end","ancestor_kind","name_id","name_source","value_id","value_kind","type_id","type_start","type_end","type_kind","function_id","function_start","function_end","function_kind","object_id","object_start","object_end","object_kind","object_source","attribute_id","attribute_source","body_id","body_start","body_end","body_kind","parameters_id","parameters_start","parameters_end","parameters_kind","name","class_name","region_start","legacy_decorator","decorator","default_target","external","pure","target" FROM (SELECT f.*,coalesce((SELECT target FROM target_values t WHERE t.__path=f.__path AND t.decorator_start=(SELECT __start FROM legacy_decorators d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id) ORDER BY t.__start LIMIT 1),default_target) target FROM function_contracts f)

stages.name: last_functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end",NULL AS "id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind","name","class_name",NULL AS "region_start",NULL AS "legacy_decorator",NULL AS "decorator",NULL AS "default_target",NULL AS "external","pure",NULL AS "target",NULL AS "chosen" FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT f.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,class_name,name ORDER BY __end DESC) chosen FROM function_targets f) WHERE chosen=1)

stages.name: body_statements
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "id","kind","value_kind","value_text","callee","callee_kind" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,n.id,n.kind,v.kind value_kind,v.text value_text,c.callee,c.callee_kind FROM owned_functions f JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=f.__path AND n.parent=f.body_id LEFT JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id AND v.ordinal=0 LEFT JOIN calls c ON c.__path=v.__path AND c.id=v.id WHERE n.kind!='comment')

stages.name: stubs
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id","adapter","abstract" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id,
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM body_statements b WHERE b.__path=f.__path AND b.fn=f.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM body_statements b WHERE b.__path=f.__path AND b.fn=f.id AND NOT (b.kind IN ('pass_statement','raise_statement','delete_statement') OR b.kind='expression_statement' AND (b.value_kind IN ('string','concatenated_string') AND rx_matches(b.value_text,'(?i)^[ru]*["'']') OR b.value_kind='ellipsis' OR b.callee_kind='identifier' AND b.callee IN ('_legacy_delegate_stub','_legacy_delegate_stub_async')))) adapter,
        NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM body_statements b WHERE b.__path=f.__path AND b.fn=f.id AND NOT (b.kind IN ('pass_statement','raise_statement') OR b.kind='expression_statement' AND (b.value_kind IN ('string','concatenated_string') AND rx_matches(b.value_text,'(?i)^[ru]*["'']') OR b.value_kind='ellipsis'))) abstract FROM owned_functions f)

stages.name: parameter_pieces
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","name","type" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE pieces(__path,fn,name,rest,piece) AS (
        SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name,replace(replace(n.text,'[','|'),']','|')||'|','' FROM parameters p JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.id=p.annotation WHERE p.kind IN ('typed_parameter','typed_default_parameter')
        UNION ALL SELECT __path,fn,name,substr(rest,instr(rest,'|')+1),trim(substr(rest,1,instr(rest,'|')-1)) FROM pieces WHERE rest!='') SELECT __path,fn,name,rx_extract(piece,'([^.]*)$',1) AS type FROM pieces WHERE piece!='')

stages.name: transaction_parameters
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","name" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT __path,fn,name FROM parameter_pieces WHERE type GLOB '*PlanScope' OR type GLOB '*Transaction' AND rx_matches(type,'Read|Write|Schema'))

stages.name: owned_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "__path:1",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end",NULL AS "id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "type_id",NULL AS "type_start",NULL AS "type_end",NULL AS "type_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "parameters_id",NULL AS "parameters_start",NULL AS "parameters_end",NULL AS "parameters_kind",NULL AS "callee_id",NULL AS "callee_kind",NULL AS "full_callee","callee","receiver" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,c.* FROM owned_functions f JOIN calls c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.__start>=f.region_start AND c.__end<=f.__end WHERE c.callee_kind='attribute')

relational.query:
SELECT d.*,CASE d.issue
      WHEN 'LAO001' THEN f.name||' is a legacy adapter but its body contains executable planning or I/O'
      WHEN 'LAO002' THEN f.name||' delegates to missing module lazy target '||f.target
      WHEN 'LAO003' THEN f.name||' delegates to '||f.target||', which is not @pure_lazy'
      WHEN 'LAO004' THEN '@pure_lazy surface '||f.name||' reaches eager terminal '||(SELECT min(c.callee) FROM owned_calls c WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND c.fn=f.id AND c.callee IN ('execute','execute_async','fetch','fetch_async','resolve','resolve_async') )
      WHEN 'LAO005' THEN 'transaction-facing function '||f.name||' owns eager calls '||(SELECT group_concat(callee,', ') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.callee FROM owned_calls c JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver AND receiver.kind='identifier' JOIN transaction_parameters p ON p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.fn AND p.name=receiver.text WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND c.fn=f.id AND c.callee NOT GLOB '*_lazy' ORDER BY c.callee))||' instead of delegating to one @pure_lazy surface'
      WHEN 'LAO006' THEN 'async transaction-facing function '||f.name||' has no awaited I/O and is not a legacy adapter' END message FROM (SELECT f.__path path,f.__start start_byte,f.__end end_byte,'LAO001' issue,f.id identity FROM function_targets f WHERE legacy_decorator IS NOT NULL AND NOT (SELECT adapter FROM stubs s WHERE s.__path=f.__path AND s.id=f.id) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path path,f.__start start_byte,f.__end end_byte,'LAO002' issue,f.id identity FROM function_targets f WHERE legacy_decorator IS NOT NULL AND class_name IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM last_functions t WHERE t.__path=f.__path AND t.class_name IS f.class_name AND t.name=f.target) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path path,f.__start start_byte,f.__end end_byte,'LAO003' issue,f.id identity FROM function_targets f WHERE legacy_decorator IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM last_functions t WHERE t.__path=f.__path AND t.class_name IS f.class_name AND t.name=f.target AND NOT t.pure) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path path,f.__start start_byte,f.__end end_byte,'LAO004' issue,f.id identity FROM function_targets f WHERE pure AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM owned_calls c WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND c.fn=f.id AND c.callee IN ('execute','execute_async','fetch','fetch_async','resolve','resolve_async')) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path path,f.__start start_byte,f.__end end_byte,'LAO005' issue,f.id identity FROM function_targets f WHERE legacy_decorator IS NULL AND NOT external AND NOT pure AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM owned_calls c JOIN nodes object ON object.__path=c.__path AND object.id=c.receiver JOIN transaction_parameters p ON p.__path=c.__path AND p.fn=c.fn AND p.name=object.text WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND c.fn=f.id AND object.kind='identifier' AND c.callee NOT GLOB '*_lazy') UNION ALL SELECT f.__path path,f.__start start_byte,f.__end end_byte,'LAO006' issue,f.id identity FROM function_targets f WHERE rx_matches(f.text,'^async\b') AND legacy_decorator IS NULL AND NOT external AND NOT (SELECT abstract FROM stubs s WHERE s.__path=f.__path AND s.id=f.id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM transaction_parameters p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.fn=f.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=f.__path AND n.kind='await' AND n.__start>=f.region_start AND n.__end<=f.__end)) d JOIN function_targets f ON f.__path=d.path AND f.id=d.identity
